# Project Instructions

This workspace contains a Next.js project management app with authentication, role-based access control, projects, tasks, and dashboard APIs.

- Use Prisma with PostgreSQL for both local development and Railway deployment.
- Keep REST API routes under `src/app/api`.
- Enforce `Admin` and `Member` roles in server-side code.
- Keep validation centralized in `src/lib/validators.ts`.
- Update the README when new setup or deployment steps are added.
